Think vegetarian food means just roti and sabzi? Think again!
This World Vegetarian Day, we’re bringing you 4 delicious vegetarian recipes that showcase just how much variety, flavour and texture vegetarian food has to offer.
From crispy Railway Vegetable Cutlets and rich Veg Hyderabadi Handi, to aromatic Guchchi Pulao and soft, flavourful Palak Paratha, there’s something for every kind of vegetarian food lover.
These recipes bring together different flavours, textures and cooking styles to create a delicious vegetarian spread that goes far beyond the everyday meal.
